dress.bodice_flat_cut_mandate.description: MANDATORY: Bodice flat-cut construction for AMAB body
dress.bodice_flat_cut_mandate.contents: BODICE CONSTRUCTION: Flat-cut pattern with NO darts, NO shaping, NO bust accommodation. Fabric hangs STRAIGHT DOWN from shoulder seams in vertical plane. NO curves, NO projection, NO following of chest contours. Flat panel construction like menswear. Bodice designed for FLAT CHEST - cuts vertically without breast shaping.

dress.skirt_tulle_cloud_layers.description: Tulle skirt with massive cloud-like layered volume
dress.skirt_tulle_cloud_layers.contents: Tulle skirt with 8-12 layers creating enormous cloud-like volume. Skirt projects 15-20 inches horizontally from waist. Multiple tulle tiers stacked creating dramatic silhouette.

dress.neckline_high_standing_ruffle.description: High standing ruffle neckline - couture detail
dress.neckline_high_standing_ruffle.contents: FLAT CHEST - NO BREASTS. Bodice hangs straight down from shoulders with ZERO chest projection, ZERO curves, ZERO breast form visible. Completely flat front. NECKLINE VISIBLE FROM OVERHEAD. High standing ruffle collar (4-6cm) at perimeter boundary where frame ends around base of neck. Ruffles gathered with precision creating vertical texture. Scalloped binding detail. Full coverage from collar down with no cleavage. Neckline detail visible in overhead view.

dress.neckline_peter_pan_lace.description: Peter Pan collar with lace overlay
dress.neckline_peter_pan_lace.contents: FLAT CHEST - NO BREASTS. Bodice hangs straight down from shoulders with ZERO chest projection, ZERO curves, ZERO breast form visible. Completely flat front. NECKLINE VISIBLE FROM OVERHEAD. Flat Peter Pan collar at high neckline with floral lace overlay on base, at perimeter boundary where frame ends around base of neck. Soft gathered ruffles at collar edge creating playful texture. Full coverage from collar down with no cleavage. Neckline detail visible in overhead view.

dress.lace_overlay_strategic.description: Strategic floral lace overlay - couture detail
dress.lace_overlay_strategic.contents: Bodice features floral lace overlay. Large blooms (4-5cm) in white or cream. Lace trim on neckline, armholes, tier seams.

dress.embroidery_architectural.contents: Architectural embroidery (geometric or botanical shapes). 2-3cm motifs on bodice and upper skirt. Monochromatic or slightly contrasting thread.

dress.openwork_lace_lattice.description: Architectural openwork lace pattern - haute couture
dress.openwork_lace_lattice.contents: Openwork lace lattice pattern on bodice. Geometric cutout grid with skin visible beneath. Delicate diagonal or rectangular grid.

dress.binding_multicolor_accent.contents: Neckline, armholes, and tier seams bound with accent ribbon. Clean finished edges with visible stitching.

dress.gathering_controlled_grid.description: Controlled gathering with architectural grid pattern
dress.gathering_controlled_grid.contents: Gathering in organized grid pattern. Gathered sections alternate with flat panels. Stitching visible as linear detail.

dress.hem_scalloped_hand_finished.description: Hand-scalloped hem edge - refined couture finishing
dress.hem_scalloped_hand_finished.contents: Hem edge finished with scalloped wave pattern. Each scallop identical curved arc. Delicate stitching and enclosed binding.

dress.seams_finished_contrast_binding.description: Visible seams with contrast binding - couture detail
dress.seams_finished_contrast_binding.contents: Seams visible as design element. Bound with accent ribbon.

dress.tiered_layered_sophisticated.contents: Skirt features 3-4 tiers stacked vertically creating layering. Each tier has gathering creating volume. Delicate ribbon trim separates tiers.

dress.petticoat_extreme_architectural.description: Extreme petticoat volume - most special day construction
dress.petticoat_extreme_architectural.contents: PETTICOAT EXTREME VOLUME. Skirt projects 15-20 inches horizontally from body. Skirt WIDER than tall. Multiple petticoat layers visible at hem creating enormous bell shape. MOST SPECIAL DAY aesthetic.

dress.sparkle_distributed_dimensional.description: Dense sparkle with dimensional light refraction - maximum special day
dress.sparkle_distributed_dimensional.contents: Dense sparkle across dress with glitter, sequins, rhinestones. Light catches from all angles. Dress GLEAMS.

dress.ribbon_bow_structured_placement.description: Structured ribbon bows with strategic placement
dress.ribbon_bow_structured_placement.contents: Large structured ribbon bows (6-12cm) at strategic junctures. Waist bow as focal point with long tails. Bows in coordinating pastels.

dress.neckline_high_square.description: High square neckline with ruffled playfulness
dress.neckline_high_square.contents: FLAT CHEST - NO BREASTS. Bodice hangs straight down from shoulders with ZERO chest projection, ZERO curves, ZERO breast form visible. Completely flat front. NECKLINE VISIBLE FROM OVERHEAD. Square neckline sits high at collarbone with clean horizontal lines at perimeter edge where frame cuts around neck/shoulder junction. Bodice fabric covers fully from collarbone down. Gathered ruffle at neckline edge (2-3cm width) adds playful texture without cleavage. Structured binding detail. Neckline detail visible in overhead view.

dress.neckline_round_gathered.contents: FLAT CHEST - NO BREASTS. Bodice hangs straight down from shoulders with ZERO chest projection, ZERO curves, ZERO breast form visible. Completely flat front. NECKLINE VISIBLE FROM OVERHEAD. Round neckline opening with gathered bodice fabric and frills at neckline edge, at perimeter boundary where frame ends around base of neck. Multiple small ruffles with textured surface. Sits high providing full coverage from neck down with no cleavage. Neckline detail visible in overhead view.

dress.neckline_ribbon_tie_front.description: Modest neckline with front ribbon tie accent
dress.neckline_ribbon_tie_front.contents: FLAT CHEST - NO BREASTS. Bodice hangs straight down from shoulders with ZERO chest projection, ZERO curves, ZERO breast form visible. Completely flat front. NECKLINE VISIBLE FROM OVERHEAD. Modest high neckline with pastel ribbon ties at front center, at perimeter boundary where frame ends around base of neck. Ribbon bows or knot detail adds playful focal point. Full coverage from neck down with no cleavage. Neckline detail visible in overhead view.

dress.neckline_peter_pan_medium.contents: Flat Peter Pan collar at neckline. Lace and ruffle detail at collar edge. High neckline with sweet styling.

dress.neckline_high_ruffle_medium.description: High standing ruffle neckline - medium distance
dress.neckline_high_ruffle_medium.contents: High standing ruffle collar. Gathered ruffles with defined structure. Covers neckline area.

dress.neckline_round_medium.contents: Round neckline with gathered bodice and frills. Textured ruffle detail at neck edge. High coverage.
